== Biography ==
Phoebe was born about 1793. She passed away in 1832. 
=== Parentage ===

David Faris's dedicated genealogy of [[Glasgow-12|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Barclay-56|Rosanna Barclay]] identifies '''Phoebe Glasgow''' among their ten children. This family reconstruction agrees with the migration and sibling evidence summarized on Robert's profile, so both parent relationships are treated as confident.

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-12]] is assessed at 89% (probable). Faris’s 1990 Glasgow Family genealogy places Phoebe among Robert and Rosanna’s ten children and cites her marriage at p.37. Her 1793–1832 memorial and Adams County family agree with the selected Robert.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Read Faris’s Phoebe entry and its original supporting records.
